expected.expected_answer: Paid monthly in arrears: work from day 1 to day 30 of a calendar month is paid on the 7th day of the following month. Pay is calculated from hours approved by DT3/Client, submitted weekly by timecard. DT3 does NOT withhold taxes - the consultant is responsible for all taxes. result.answer: DT3 payments are made on a monthly basis [1]. Specifically, work performed from Day 1 to Day 30 of a calendar month is paid on the 7th day of the following month [1]. The pay is calculated based on the number of hours approved by DT3 or the Client, which the consultant must submit weekly through a timecard [1]. Additionally, DT3 does not withhold taxes, meaning the consultant is solely responsible for all taxes in accordance with country, federal, and state laws [1].
